predecessors.name: Duchy of Holstein
predecessors.text: the Gottorp shares of Schleswig and Holstein: Gottorf, Eiderstedt, Kiel, Fehmarn

successors.name: Duchy of Oldenburg (Grand Duchy from 1815)
successors.text: the Holstein-Gottorp lands left after 1721 round Kiel and Fehmarn

ledger.x: 1544: Adolf, son of Frederick I, receives the one-third duchy of Schleswig and Holstein.
1721: Gottorp Schleswig share lost to Denmark after the Great Northern War (Frederiksborg 1720).
1773: Tsarskoye Selo exchange; Holstein-Gottorp given up for Oldenburg and Delmenhorst.

certainty.note: Page has no area or boundaries; hulls round seats.
